action.objective: Play c4 to expand on the queenside and challenge Black's center/queen, keeping the king sheltered on c1.
action.rationale: c2c4 is the only commit_ready move: verified exact at depth 2 (-108, best broad-search score) with safety.complete true, no mate-in-one and tactical_refutation not_found over Black checks Qxc4+/Nxb3+/Nxe2. It gains space, attacks b5/d5, and is supported by b3/d3. d1d2 (-122) is shallower and inferior, so no switch is justified.
